messages.subject: Simulation in vessels
parts:
Hi, I recently found this package.  I need to write some simulation code related with vessels loading inventory from a warehouse. One of the scenarios in the simulation is related with tides, which ones stop the operation and bringing some possible extra costs.

One possible scenario is:

1) Vessel arrives at port.
2) Port is opened.
3) Vessel is loading cargo
4) Port is declared closed because tides and vessel did not complete cargo.
5) Port is opened
6) Vessel is loading the remaining cargo.
7) Vessel completed cargo
8) Vessel leaves port.

Is there some way to save the times between each ones of this activities for one vessel? 

Sometimes the port is closed and the same vessel did not complete the cargo because the available operation time is not enough, is there some way to repeat the activity "loading cargo" until complete it?

This is my first experience writing this kind of codes, so I would be grateful if you can help me.

Matías

> Hi, I recently found this package. I need to write some simulation code
> related with vessels loading inventory from a warehouse. One of the
> scenarios in the simulation is related with tides, which ones stop the
> operation and bringing some possible extra costs.

There are multiple ways of doing this. First of all, you need a model:
you need to decide what is a resource and what is a process; and
sometimes not, but sometimes it depends on the metrics you want to
compute.

> One possible scenario is:
>
> 1) Vessel arrives at port.
> 2) Port is opened.
> 3) Vessel is loading cargo
> 4) Port is declared closed because tides and vessel did not complete cargo.
> 5) Port is opened
> 6) Vessel is loading the remaining cargo.
> 7) Vessel completed cargo
> 8) Vessel leaves port.
>
> Is there some way to save the times between each ones of this activities for
> one vessel?

simmer provides automated monitoring of everything: each process'
lifetime is recorded; each time there's a change in a resource, it is
recorded. You have to think about your model, and automatically you'll
get data frames with everything that happened to compute summaries and
statistics.

> Sometimes the port is closed and the same vessel did not complete the cargo
> because the available operation time is not enough, is there some way to
> repeat the activity "loading cargo" until complete it?

If you model the port as a preemptive resource, then you can program
your tides to seize the whole port with maximum priority, so that
everything stops until the tide releases the port again. Then, vessels
automatically resume their activity.

> This is my first experience writing this kind of codes, so I would be
> grateful if you can help me.

There are numerous vignettes. I suggest you to start playing with the
code there, especifically those examples involving preemptive
resources.

>
> Matías

Iñaki
